"text": "«Madame...»", "sha256": "a8638e06b90ee2250935fa359a4d01317275a1436ffb2cc51422343cc49a5eb1", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3871], "source_xml_sha256": "0f10b5c81f680231b768c01f51d8941e200a6d828f845f14dfdaba77cf3099f7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0225", "text": "Elle l'interrompit d'une voix très basse et furieuse: «Que demandes-tu?", "sha256": "d1e5422e2b39b193529084696d3f2e2461741142d23e4850b506128362ff29fc", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3872], "source_xml_sha256": "7d3758dc483ff982f7723e0e190c86d5cd27e368598b7673b4755394e70d6787", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0226", "text": "—Ce n'est pas vous, dit-il, c'est l'autre.", "sha256": "48ee03367ea96b2b587c56cb5f6a6ab1ee7431c7e6bb005b0384427a1f3b0abf", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3873], "source_xml_sha256": "47b435162e90eedaa5b4deb5b599577f147463c1a5588351c5b310145ff9835f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0227", "text": "—Quelle autre?", "sha256": "cb37198c4e85a2e35ff92eb5690f6b96322283b6f11893156f51cfc018111c2b", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3874], "source_xml_sha256": "8637d017839c2626ec3a076e9c0b3b1bae8b800d1dcf031b97a46588c7fb0fad", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0228", "text": "—La jeune.»", "sha256": "4942c42eefed79f235ce520064268794d0dedd936a7257fe8b8847b4793e0b8e", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3875], "source_xml_sha256": "16c4cc8271f23c7751a54e3a385ecef89ca9cb9b80c7d6ece0db7bdd30d89aba", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0229", "text": "Elle se mit à secouer la tête en criant: «Il n'y a personne! Il n'y a personne! Il n'y a personne!", "sha256": "82041d2d54425262803e8def758cd0b750f89a847c8320baf0079f054866bc95", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3876], "source_xml_sha256": "c420eda69bd1123ad82ad608721d127510edef1a440b850a9086669695930170", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0230", "text": "—Si! reprit le bourreau, vous le savez bien. Laissez-moi prendre la jeune. Je ne veux pas vous faire de mal, à vous.»", "sha256": "b19fbe7867ad1096bdda0d080dde4842da2e12158436f96d247225a0f3d63f21", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3877], "source_xml_sha256": "8eeb78c6369dce4d2356e03b12ac33df0c5128aaaf3de262a99c2f75847c6f47", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0231", "text": "Elle dit avec un ricanement étrange:", "sha256": "3af7262351d2dac372ea922f53e749a0109eca27be118c63ea8cc7e256d14673", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3878], "source_xml_sha256": "dec07b6e4169f5b4e1aef89324a0a2571755275138d2781b870095fe2362295a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0232", "text": "«Ah! tu ne veux pas me faire de mal, à moi!", "sha256": "2e444b4e73a151dc178dba517370b34b9741806c9f3950d32fb92ea021269069", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3879], "source_xml_sha256": "547846add432bbdea41e87ae72dfd509612b4d2bae3be5029da05aa111afd968", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0233", "text": "—Laissez-moi l'autre, madame; c'est monsieur le prévôt qui le veut.»", "sha256": "fe507d18af04975877195f1a6e32ff4dee11a95a296d462e65bd5584f32b10ce", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3880], "source_xml_sha256": "929a9a263b0c5df290f3be7b47c2fd9b24bf17ba07fd3ff71421f5b3e519aa99", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0234", "text": "Elle répéta d'un air de folie: «Il n'y a personne.", "sha256": "a256988844b3997a3939775a4753024044f03a48ac225d7f15593d418c9e58c0", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3881], "source_xml_sha256": "088915daf9b60f1202d21be8da07b9a682e5470495bd56992afc18305f23db89", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0235", "text": "—Je vous dis que si! répliqua le bourreau. Nous avons tous vu que vous étiez deux.", "sha256": "bc95241faa213fad7f30348d817ceabdbdff707edcc5160aa9fb6b34155e804b", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3882], "source_xml_sha256": "eba5107de2252c3b336d28c1910124eb775225fe46e6d73b97bdd8f075eb67d1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0236", "text": "—Regarde plutôt! dit la recluse en ricanant. Fourre ta tête par la lucarne.»", "sha256": "9619f6010a695f24fc7d2ccf727e1b6531dc146d7b0828206d2ab92d59665807", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3883], "source_xml_sha256": "2d21acd572bdc2ef914e07123e88d47748456dd64c23f7e80bb22247a5524d0b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0237", "text": "Le bourreau examina les ongles de la mère, et n'osa pas.", "sha256": "5d3dca4e6710689191c8356fdcf3252804cba002e8e1da50578ff88c1712e1e6", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3884], "source_xml_sha256": "3d1cf6168df11fb750ec80e4b1afb683153d1932775abe52f65582caed97854a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0238", "text": "«Dépêche!» cria Tristan qui venait de ranger sa troupe en cercle autour du Trou aux Rats et qui se tenait à cheval près du gibet.", "sha256": "d393c3a248dfb1665fc947dba3dd39a564b15a8a1a1422d11c8025b77b936e4e", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3885], "source_xml_sha256": "3c27122b26fcc772e4e53992faa5cfb6cb9e041408aeac6d984a264af71870b4", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0239", "text": "Henriet revint au prévôt encore une fois, tout embarrassé. Il avait posé sa corde à terre, et roulait d'un air gauche son chapeau dans ses mains.", "sha256": "7892915ba31dcb5474cde49ccb4af5ea5db462b876c83f40f377b92a2b169bb4", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3886], "source_xml_sha256": "b2981707c66e164af453791955f2b502f3c9b790cfec4fb9050af77535b37efc", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0240", "text": "«Monseigneur, demanda-t-il, par où entrer?", "sha256": "4b85818dc0c134e8b6b80693d9a207ed200c69345a415b3b3d259187d313b4d6", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3887], "source_xml_sha256": "25150a4ead76123d95fffdbc36f4a8d8a1b00639c28b61f1f610c5efa91101c7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0241", "text": "«Par la porte.", "sha256": "85ed867dc59b924fe5b2cb7ac70a25c28b1363411ef78734ce42c42b9599b5b8", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3888], "source_xml_sha256": "688b7a5877fb81d84e89e1958aa9e3b6d9db6ec536d8e0ae9545d3be0a309bf0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0242", "text": "—Il n'y en a pas.", "sha256": "5ddd9e1a4625853303482cce5d2afd5a23f31d0807a4f159b3fa32a48d3e78e0", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3889], "source_xml_sha256": "52d8b90db9032e57f0f24a01c95422aba08152766ef97f891027f7f9f7b32a85", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0243", "text": "—Par la fenêtre.", "sha256": "42d96d852b271d1dbf9eaaea6cc1491b5bb6609cb64f8265b9bb27eb7460516a", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3890], "source_xml_sha256": "ceb44c7e46600de5793441157d7044d198b4bc83720c6af2e0bba23741f9cfd7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0244", "text": "—Elle est trop étroite.", "sha256": "447faed7f8a780fd1cf96569bce84cb651e649d0da93f671884343570d532ef0", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3891], "source_xml_sha256": "6accb593b3a3bd535d58d955080224a626f901c62ce8e81122b2deeac977f54c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0245", "text": "—Élargis-la, dit Tristan avec colère. N'as-tu pas des pioches?»", "sha256": "88d5fe6a3d7985040749e633d131fadc45781ef1e43f5ad9a382d8d6794ebad8", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3892], "source_xml_sha256": "d013a261139c7c7537ed222be69757e87fb17629695d579ab895298538a76e55", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0246", "text": "Du fond de son antre, la mère, toujours en arrêt, regardait. Elle n'espérait plus rien, elle ne savait plus ce qu'elle voulait, mais elle ne voulait pas qu'on lui prît sa fille.", "sha256": "5db0ede3e967fe90f221d6320f2c7b344b11f081fcbc03d7a716e685f274d555", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3893], "source_xml_sha256": "b93b10c9da99ba6049a45c8f72e1db7de810714dcd0ed4b6d5255618d8ce7b36", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0247", "text": "Henriet Cousin alla chercher la caisse d'outils des basses œuvres sous le hangar de la Maison-aux-Piliers. Il en retira aussi la double échelle qu'il appliqua sur-le-champ au gibet. Cinq ou six hommes de la prévôté s'armèrent de pics et de leviers, et Tristan se dirigea avec eux vers la lucarne.", "sha256": "b6d7be9df478a53c65a2d22583f46e9cd789ebf79b6230a28c443451f7f68c43", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3894], "source_xml_sha256": "96a943b9744f66eed410cf50c56edbe6d5f06a375a3275f9da11a7cb138b68ae", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0248", "text": "«La vieille, dit le prévôt d'un ton sévère, livre-nous cette fille de bonne grâce.»", "sha256": "d826a56c9c71898bc17aaf25555cb4d0b77d92c9f9a2f70dfbdf3bffd8629e51", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3895], "source_xml_sha256": "57b48ad0f12f523cef62dbb666ffd198f2412cab91555157b33f7218f2a99e5a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0249", "text": "Elle le regarda comme quand on ne comprend pas.", "sha256": "636e64df9b0fb33e93e6a8fc0436aa4dea6836f77140d5bec6ae3154cba2c9a4", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3896], "source_xml_sha256": "36cb92bbb5f6554940a33817c39338daf214c5f68b6b3291c561bdfccbeeb363", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0250", "text": "«Tête-Dieu! reprit Tristan, qu'as-tu donc à empêcher cette sorcière d'être pendue comme il plaît au roi?»", "sha256": "bf3ff130b9093d5ec730df42a92693cc289ad7a835c5b473a7fb0ce9121b909e", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3897], "source_xml_sha256": "06a2b34e1591ac223bb23952b089fdae5403daaea80304d1afbc35fbfa12398a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0251", "text": "La misérable se mit à rire de son rire farouche.", "sha256": "f20ff51e017a912fe38d5b3376bbe5e5ec3351609b11df46d14ab3753cc23bb3", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3898], "source_xml_sha256": "a0c48d1cf172b51c89fe260582f8f84d78c9162aec69253466fef027ab75695a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0252", "text": "«Ce que j'y ai? C'est ma fille.»", "sha256": "e56bc5be55bff0a8f296701d4cf3fd5d7e8f5abf27e267405e3aaa308b463f4f", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3899], "source_xml_sha256": "0e4b4b4b9aced6f1be9947dfc931a49388e049d63400c13313182544f7ce6e9b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0253", "text": "L'accent dont elle prononça ce mot fit frissonner jusqu'à Henriet Cousin lui-même.", "sha256": "7731e8e29ccbca14c705ec67f8513118c0086d331320b561cf15204fb455c5ae", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3900], "source_xml_sha256": "a8ea31f133aa60ae9f0314ccc51414aafd15e0658ce041ee74aaa486610b7a24", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0254", "text": "«J'en suis fâché, repartit le prévôt. Mais c'est le bon plaisir du roi.»", "sha256": "85955ed4f0994a41f0277f6d6f3bc429cfe531889df71056ce5344fb30eafeb2", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3901], "source_xml_sha256": "1cab2aa7e00d36d9f2586ab1304b99f38972572024e9f97639e17607ff5d6138", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u058-b0255", "text": "Elle cria en redoublant son rire terrible: «Qu'est-ce que cela me fait, ton roi? Je te dis que c'est ma fille!", "sha256": "2cc9d9a3efc780d721974934c13c1e8b22956c00665ba1b1501c7aa05438fc73", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3902], "source_xml_sha256": "530e5a056d9be51b2630197dbd9d7ae2cc739acd345c50b143a5bbc7655224a9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
